node.title: The genuine residue: census + exact handling of knife-edge rows
node.statement: REFINED: with bounded scales + exact counts, the census is exact Diophantine arithmetic — windows [L(n,A), K(n,A)) in B*-space per rate/candidate, undecided rows = admissible primes landing inside. Ties exist systematically (B* sweeps all integers as q varies); the residual undecided set shrinks exactly as certification strength L grows toward K. Full grand-challenge closure requires L within O(1) of K at the tie point OR per-prime typicality; exhibited-row partials dodge entirely (census_dodge_selection).
node.attack_surface: needs acl_second_order first (the error band's width); then the census is mechanical over the descriptor family
node.falsifier: a dense knife-edge family (would mean the expansion's error model is wrong, not that adjacency fails)
